Arte is focused for one enemy, but can still catch strays
[All Enemies]

strings.860153:
[Single Ally]
Arte is focused for one ally, but may still affect 
other allies or damage enemies if close enough
[All Allies]
All allies will be affected by arte regardless of range
[Allies Only]
Arte will target allies, 
ignoring any enemy along the way
[Self]
Arte will only affect the user
